newsitem.title: USA: AMP says to take a $17.7 mln Q2 charge.
newsitem.headline: AMP says to take a $17.7 mln Q2 charge.

text.p: AMP Inc said Monday that it would take a $17.7 million pre-tax charge against second-quarter earnings to reflect a recent judgment against its Connectware subsidiary awarded by a Texas arbitration panel to IMT Inc.
The charge will result in an after-tax earnings-per-share impact of five cents, the company said.
The company said it will announce second quarter earnings on July 23.

AMP Chief Executive President William J. Hudson said the company remains comfortable with analysts' second-quarter per share earnings estimates in the range of $0.50 to $0.53, excluding this one-time item.

"We are taking this charge at this time as a matter of accounting prudence," Hudson said. "With regard to the IMT decision, we think that the decision was incorrect and the amount of the award was based neither on the terms of Connectware's contractual obligations with IMT nor on the law."
